question: Why OpenHOI3's units beside an attacked province stay and support where the original's march.

addresses.name: CAIUnit_ManageLandUnits
addresses.comment:
**The land half of CAIUnit slot 73**, the third body it calls after CAIUnit_ManageAirUnits (0x4CD890) and CAIUnit_ManageNavalUnits (0x4D0880). Extent 0x4D57F0-0x4D7F7E, 10126 bytes, 2768 instructions, read end to end by walking every branch; two `ret 4` at 0x4D7F5B and 0x4D7F7B, both in the epilogue, so trap 3 does not apply. int3 x16 before it, int3 x2 and a fresh SEH prologue at 0x4D7F80 after. Trap 2: functionStart is wrong inside it twice (functionStart(0x4D6B45)=0x4D653C, functionStart(0x4D7D00)=0x4D78FB), both isolated 0xCC bytes. One dead 5-byte `jmp`+nop at 0x4D613B. One caller, slot 73 at 0x4B0D01: unconditional when the daily-stagger flag is set, otherwise one pass in three and only when at_war, in_undeclared_war or CCountry +0xF50 > 0. Return value set at exactly one place (0x4D7AB3) and never read.

ENTRY GATE: the topmost-agent test, then the +0x12C vector must hold at least one element, then **agent->+0x364 (frontier at a shooting war) and +0x366 must both be set** - so the whole function is dead for an agent whose operations area does not border an active war.

PHASE 1 (0x4D5944-0x4D678D) scores every enemy-controlled province of agent->front_provinces (+0xC0) into a fresh CProvinceFloat {vftable 0x15EB644, 0x18D, province id, float} inserted score-descending through 0x49C330. Base weight is a 0..500 ramp on map distance from the ops area's supply depot (flat 100.0 in arcade mode), x2 in an owner area of under 3 provinces, + half each enemy neighbour's plan-objective priority, + (operable land neighbours - 1) x 50 (x20 at stance 3, x10 at stance 4), +1000 for being on agent->+0x1BC and +500 for touching it, + 5*navalBase.level_max+100. At plan stance 3 or 4 only it also adds the province's own objective priority, 90 per plan-path province it is and 45 per one it touches (for both CUnit +0x244 and +0x258), 1000 when every operable neighbour is in agent->+0x1CC, **and agent->front_province_scores (+0x294)[province] through AIOrderedMap_SubscriptFloat at 0x4D5F6B - the single instruction that consumes CAIUnit::RebuildFrontAndApproaches's output, and its only reader in the image**; plus 125/250 for a thin enemy salient and 200/400 for a split approach, and x0.25/x0.5 for a redundant pocket approach (dropped outright below stance 3).

PHASE 2 (0x4D6795-0x4D7CB9) walks the targets best first. A score of 500 or more promotes the local stance to 4. Candidate units are the agent's own leaf land units (slot 15) standing in the target's friendly neighbours, filtered on fuel, ai_held_back, slot 86, combat state and pending destination; each is scored enemyNeighbours*10 - slot89(target,unit)*10 (+100 when slot88 > 95, /10 when it belongs to another agent, /5 when it has a blocking order) into **CUnit +0x2B8**, with the number of garrisoned unattacked enemy neighbours in **CUnit +0x2BC**. **The candidates are kept in ascending order of that score** - each goes in before the first candidate scoring more (0x4D7182 `ja`, CList_InsertBefore at 0x4D71CB), ties after - **and are added lowest first**, so the score is a cost: a unit whose own province has fewer enemy neighbours, and whose terrain attack+movement modifier at the target's terrain (slot 89, CAIUnit::GetUnitTerrainModifier with attacking=1) is higher, is tried first, and a unit rated a garrison above 95 (slot 88, CAIUnit::RateUnitAsGarrison) is pushed to the back. Slot 86 (CAIUnit::IsUnitReservedForTransport) is asked again of each candidate in the commit loop (0x4D7579), as well as in the candidate filter (0x4D6DAD) and of the stand-in (0x4D7768). Units are added while 0x4D93B0's odds figure does not fall; the attack goes ahead when the figure reaches 3.0 (1.1 at stance 4, 5.0 at stance 2 for admitting more units) and at least one attacker is movable, and is called off below 0.8 - both bars collapsing to 0.2/0.01 when the target borders two or more region groups or when an attacker is unsupplied and the target has a port. **A unit that cannot be spared from its own province gets `support_attack` (0x4D7AD6); every other one gets CEU3AI::MoveUnit (0x4D7AAE).**

PHASE 3 (0x4D7CBF-0x4D7F2C) sweeps agent->+0x11C's CUnit vector and stands down units whose attack is going badly - the combat's slot 17 (CCombat::GetAttackerStrengthShare, the attacker's share in thousandths) over 0.5 when the unit is on the defending side - i.e. its side is losing, the same sense as the naval body's complemented test, or a `support_attack` whose whole attacking side is pinned - but never one whose destination is on agent->+0x1BC. Standing down is CUnit::AIStandDown (0x49AAB0): a CSetOrderCommand for a null order where the order is not already null, the unit's movement_destination_province_id zeroed on the spot, and a CCancelMovementCommand - the unit halts in the province it stands in; nothing marches it back.

**Phase 3, the calling off, read again 2026-11-10** (`FINDINGS-liveread.md`, section 20): a land battle always answers that it may be left, so a unit falling back is called off a losing defence too; a support attacker (order type 0x4E5) is stood down when every attacker of its battle answers order slot 24, which a plain move and no order do not. **The bar, on the listing 2026-11-11** (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 40): the stance at [ebp-0x38] picks 3.0 for 2 and 1.1 for 4 and 1.5 otherwise (0x4D7966; 0x162DC88, 0x151A2F0, 0x16279AC VA), 0.8 to call off (0x165C564); with [ebp-0xAC] > 1 - the distinct region groups (owner area +0x6C) of the target's friendly land neighbours, counted at 0x4D6868-0x4D69E2 - or the port flag [ebp-0x2D], 0.2 and 0.01. Each target's phase-one score is written into its CProvinceFloat at 0x4D670D. **The support flag measured 2026-11-12** (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 54): a joining unit is flagged for support_attack where its +0x2BC is above nought, its province draws on a depot (+0x48 != 0), no stand-in stands there - a stand-in being of its own country or a co-belligerent not at war with it and not already in the attackers list - and its province is not in +0x1CC; so the last of three units in one province supports, and a lone flagged unit never attacks. **The candidate gathering read again 2026-11-12** (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 58): with no pending destination (0x4D6C73) it jumps to 0x4D6D1D past the enemy-destination, garrison (+0x2C9) and nearest-agent tests, so a garrison or another agent's unit standing still is a candidate; the list is kept ascending by +0x2B8 (0x4D7186). **The dead end's sea, read 2026-11-12** (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 59): a sea neighbour of the single approach counts only where p's template coast flag (+0xA0) is set and p has an edge to the same sea province (0x4D61C7); the rule goes on with fewer than 3 operable land neighbours and no such sea (0x4D624C). **The uncovered count, read 2026-11-14** (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 85): CUnit +0x2BC is counted per unit and target at 0x4D6EF0-0x4D7061 and written at 0x4D715A - the province attacked left out (0x4D6F69); a neighbour counts where anybody stands or the holder's friends step in, or where the unit's area is one province and the neighbour's more than five; covered by a land unit of the country in the unit's own province bound there, or at stance 4 by any of the country's.
addresses.evidence: The listing 0x4D6E60-0x4D7160 read on the running game; the attack on 2213 at 21:00 on 6 September 1939 logged there.

addresses.name: CollectUnitsMovingIntoProvince
addresses.signature: void __stdcall CollectUnitsMovingIntoProvince(CMapProvince* province, CUnitList* out, bool enemiesOnly, CCountryTag tag)
addresses.comment: 0x4B1480-0x4B16EB (`ret 0x14`), read end to end, four callers (0x4CB0C3, 0x4CDC38, 0x4CE37D, 0x4D6FA8). Walks province->path_node_ptr (+0xD4)'s edge vector (+0x90/+0x94, stride 0x14); skips a neighbour whose template is not is_land (+0x13D) or whose +0x2B8 unit list is empty; per unit requires slot 15, then with enemiesOnly non-zero the inlined at-war test against `tag` (owner id +0x128 against country->+0xCA8, diplomacy +0xE28, the at-war flag +0x20, the two REB tests and UndeclaredWarCoversProvince) or with it zero CCountry::IsFriendly; then requires the unit's movement destination - provinces[unit->+0x13C[0]] when +0x140 > 0, else null - to equal `province`; then pushes unit->slot9() onto `out`. With enemiesOnly = 1, which is what both air call sites pass, it answers 'which enemy land units are marching into this province right now', and in CAIUnit_ManageAirUnits that is the airfield-evacuation trigger. **Its call at 0x4D6FA8** (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 85) passes enemiesOnly 0 and the neighbour's holder: the holder's friends stepping into it, added to its units_count for the uncovered count of CAIUnit_ManageLandUnits.
addresses.evidence: The call site read on the running game.

struct_fields.name: ai_uncovered_enemy_neighbours
struct_fields.comment: **Per-pass scratch, written only by CAIUnit_ManageLandUnits (0x4D715A), for the unit and the province it is offered.** The count, as a float, of the neighbours of the unit's province - edges not impassable, simulated, a real area, held by an enemy - **but the province attacked**, where anybody stands or the holder's friends are stepping in (or any, where the unit's area is one province and the neighbour's more than five), that no land unit of the country standing in the unit's province is bound for (at stance 4: no land unit of the country). It is the single input to the stay-or-go decision: a unit with a non-zero value, sitting in a province that draws on a supply depot (CProvince +0x48 not nought) and with no stand-in garrison available, is given a `support_attack` order instead of being marched into the target (0x4D7651, 0x4D7876). A stand-in already in the attackers list does not count, and with no stand-in a unit in the agent's target area marches all the same (FINDINGS-liveread.md, sections 54 and 85).
struct_fields.revises: comment: the province attacked is left out, and who covers a neighbour
struct_fields.evidence: The loop 0x4D6EF0-0x4D7061 and the write at 0x4D715A read on the running game.
